name: Love Language Japanese
source:
Enter your first year at Koto Gakuen and discover Japanese language through easy to learn lessons and compelling mini games. Meet new friends and unveil their story and maybe find love through your adventures.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/445800/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
进入琴都学园的第一年，通过易于学习的课程和引人入胜的小游戏探索日语。结识新朋友，揭开他们的故事，也许还能在冒险中找到爱情。

[来源：[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/445800/]Steam[/url]]
